WITH per_status AS (
  SELECT
    CENTROMEA,
    AVG(CASE WHEN GOT IS NOT NULL AND GPT IS NOT NULL THEN GOT - GPT END) AS avg_ast_alt,
    AVG(CASE WHEN APTT IS NOT NULL AND PT IS NOT NULL THEN APTT - PT END) AS avg_aptt_pt
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE WBC >= 6.5
  GROUP BY CENTROMEA
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_ast_alt) AS avg_of_status_ast_alt_averages,
  AVG(avg_aptt_pt) AS avg_of_status_aptt_pt_averages
FROM per_status
